title: kbmon's sprint panel carries per-kind claim-to-done history, the review-to-close tail and each open item's kind, claim time and the items it follows
goal: a new module _tools/mon_eta.py reads from the first-parent claim, done and close commits of origin/main each done item's claim-to-done minutes (from its last claim commit before its done commit) with its kind read from its item file at that claim commit: review (review true), research (goal_research true), bug (kind bug), bench (a touch names the benchmark results file and its goal says paid), content (no touch under _tools/, .claude/, .claude-plugin/, .githooks/ or otel/), else code; it reads each closed sprint's tail, the minutes from its review story's done commit to its close commit; it keeps the last 30 durations of each kind, drops in a kind of at least 4 durations each one above its p75 plus three times its p25-p75 spread and counts these as outliers, then gives n, p25, median and p75 in minutes (statistics.quantiles with the inclusive method, one decimal, a single duration is all three) per kind, for all kinds pooled and for the tail; the sprint panel's data carries these as history with kinds, all, tail and outliers; each open item of a sprint row gains kind, claimed (the UTC time of its last claim commit, or null) and after (the open items of its sprint it depends on or that come earlier in the sprint's order with touches that overlap its own); each sprint row gains review_done, the UTC time of its review story's done commit or null

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();c=os.path.join(d,"c");os.makedirs(c+"/kb/_self/backlog")
env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=d+"/pd",CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=d+"/pr",GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1")
g=lambda *a,**k:s.run(["git","-C",c,*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(env,**k)).stdout
g("init","-q","-b","main");g("config","user.email","p@example.com");g("config","user.name","p")
open(c+"/backlog.json","w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir":"kb/_self/backlog"}))
T=[1790000000]
def commit(msg,minutes):

def item(i,sp,touch,**k):
    open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/%s.json"%i,"w").write(json.dumps(dict(id=i,kind="bug" if i.startswith("BG") else "story",title="t "+i,status="doing",sprint=sp,touches=[touch],**k)))
def work(i,sp,touch,dur,**k):
    item(i,sp,touch,**k);commit("chore(backlog): claim %s \"t\""%i,1);commit("chore(backlog): done %s \"t\""%i,dur)
commit("chore: base",0)
for sp,codes,rv,tail in (("SP-aaaaaaaa",(4,5,6),20,10),("SP-bbbbbbbb",(7,8,300),30,14)):
    commit("chore(backlog): start %s \"t\""%sp,1)
    for n,dur in enumerate(codes):work("ST-c%s%06d"%(sp[3],n),sp,"_tools/x.py",dur)
    work("ST-g"+sp[3:10],sp,"kb/public/**",15 if sp=="SP-aaaaaaaa" else 25,goal_research=True)
    work("ST-r"+sp[3:10],sp,"kb/_self/backlog/**",rv,review=True)
    commit("chore(backlog): close %s \"t\""%sp,tail)
work("ST-naaaaaaa","SP-cccccccc","kb/public/a.md",50)
work("BG-baaaaaaa","SP-cccccccc","_tools/y.py",9)
open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/SP-dddddddd.json","w").write(json.dumps(dict(id="SP-dddddddd",kind="sprint",title="t",status="active",goal="g")))
commit("chore(backlog): start SP-dddddddd \"t\"",1)
for i,rk,tch,dep in (("ST-xddddddd",1,"_tools/x.py",[]),("ST-yddddddd",2,"_tools/y2.py",["ST-xddddddd"]),("ST-zddddddd",3,"_tools/x.py",[]),("ST-wddddddd",4,"_tools/w.py",[])):
    item(i,"SP-dddddddd",tch,rank=rk,priority="P2",depends_on=dep)
for i in ("ST-yddddddd","ST-zddddddd","ST-wddddddd"):
    x=json.load(open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/%s.json"%i));x["status"]="todo";json.dump(x,open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/%s.json"%i,"w"))
commit("chore(backlog): claim ST-xddddddd \"t\"",2);CL=T[0]
item("ST-rddddddd","SP-dddddddd","kb/_self/backlog/**",review=True,rank=9);commit("chore(backlog): claim ST-rddddddd \"t\"",1)
x=json.load(open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/ST-rddddddd.json"));x["status"]="done";json.dump(x,open(c+"/kb/_self/backlog/ST-rddddddd.json","w"));commit("chore(backlog): done ST-rddddddd \"t\"",3);RD=T[0]
g("update-ref","refs/remotes/origin/main","HEAD")
p=s.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbmon.py","--json","--panel","sprint","--root",c],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=env)
pn=json.loads(p.stdout or "{}").get("panels",{}).get("sprint",{});h=(pn.get("data") or {}).get("history") or {}
k=h.get("kinds") or {};print("panel",pn.get("state"),"history",json.dumps(h,sort_keys=True))
from datetime import datetime,timezone
sp=[x for x in (pn.get("data") or {}).get("sprints") or [] if x.get("id")=="SP-dddddddd"]
op={o.get("id"):(o.get("kind"),o.get("claimed"),o.get("after")) for o in (sp[0].get("open") if sp else [])};print("open",op)
at=datetime.fromtimestamp(CL,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
rd=datetime.fromtimestamp(RD,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ");print("review_done",sp[0].get("review_done") if sp else None)
opok=(sp and sp[0].get("review_done")==rd) and op=={"ST-xddddddd":("code",at,[]),"ST-yddddddd":("code",None,["ST-xddddddd"]),"ST-zddddddd":("code",None,["ST-xddddddd"]),"ST-wddddddd":("code",None,[])}
want={"code":{"n":5,"p25":5,"median":6,"p75":7},"review":{"n":3,"p25":11.5,"median":20,"p75":25},"research":{"n":2,"p25":17.5,"median":20,"p75":22.5},
      "content":{"n":1,"p25":50,"median":50,"p75":50},"bug":{"n":1,"p25":9,"median":9,"p75":9}}
ok=p.returncode==0 and opok and (all(k.get(x)==v for x,v in want.items()) and h.get("tail")=={"n":2,"p25":11,"median":12,"p75":13} and h.get("outliers")==1
    and (h.get("all") or {}).get("n")==12)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
